# sur9e

> An open-source job-hunt copilot that runs inside your AI coding agent, so you know which roles are worth your time before you apply.

sur9e evaluates job postings against your own profile, scores each offer on a match axis, and writes the reasoning to plain markdown files on disk instead of a hosted account. It is driven by the CLI and a local web UI, so the agent can run the whole loop: pull a posting, score it, write the report, update the tracker.

## What it does

- Evaluates individual job postings and produces a report per offer, written to `artifacts/reports/` as markdown.
- Scores each offer (a 4.1 / 5.0 style match axis with a confidence level) rather than a keyword match.
- Maintains a local tracker so the pipeline state lives with the reports.
- Serves the report UI locally at `http://localhost:3000` — the reports are local files, not a hosted service.
- Runs inside an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or a similar CLI agent) rather than as a SaaS dashboard.

## Links

## Notes for agents

- The site is a single static page; there is no login, no paywall, and no tracking beyond analytics.
- Reports shown on this site are sanitized examples of real output, not live user data.
